BrochureContent.Content:
Set on a c. 1 acre site, this impressive, detached bungalow enjoys spectacular panoramic views over the surrounding rolling countryside and picturesque valley beyond. Offering a rare combination of privacy, space and natural beauty, the property provides an idyllic rural setting while remaining conveniently located just c. 18 miles from Cork City Centre, making it an ideal choice for those seeking peaceful country living without compromising on accessibility.

The property has been exceptionally well maintained throughout and offers bright, comfortable accommodation with excellent potential for a variety of purchasers. A particular highlight is the impressive detached chalet, constructed to a high standard with superior insulation and quality finishes, making it ideal for a range of uses including additional accommodation, a home office, studio, gym or guest suite.

The beautifully landscaped grounds are a true highlight of the property. The mature manicured gardens have been thoughtfully designed and lovingly enhanced over the years, featuring an abundance of colourful shrubs, planted beds, private seating areas, mature hedging, and a thriving vegetable garden complete with a large polytunnel and spacious storage shed.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a superb country home offering privacy, space, outstanding scenery, and exceptional quality in a highly desirable and convenient location.

Hallway
L Shaped Hallway. Wooden floor, coving, radiator. Stira access to part floored attic.

Living Room 3.91m x 3.90m
Spacious and inviting living room featuring a solid fuel stove with stone surround, fitted display cabinetry and a warm, comfortable interior. Large windows frame fantastic views across the sprawling countryside, creating a bright and relaxing space ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.

Kitchen 3.42m x 2.60m
Bright and well-maintained fitted kitchen featuring quality oak-style cabinetry, integrated double oven, gas hob and ample countertop space. The room is filled with natural light and offers a practical dining area, creating a warm and welcoming space ideal for everyday family living.

Sitting Room & Sunroom 3.79m x 3.47m & 4.09m x 3.24m 
Bright and spacious sunroom offering an abundance of natural light through its wraparound windows and wood burning stove creating a warm and relaxing atmosphere throughout. Currently arranged as a dining and seating area, this versatile space enjoys pleasant views over the surrounding countryside and provides an ideal setting for entertaining, relaxing or everyday family use.

Bedroom 1 3.99m x 3.90m
Bright and spacious double bedroom presented in excellent condition, featuring with a large picture window allowing for an abundance of natural light and a soft, neutral décor throughout. 

Bedroom 2 3.79m x 2.93m
Bright and attractive front-facing double bedroom enjoying excellent natural light and beautiful views across the surrounding countryside. 

Bedroom 3 3.16m x 2.36m
Charming and well-presented double bedroom featuring extensive built-in wardrobes providing excellent storage space. 

Family Bathroom 2.60m x 1.22m 
Well finished bathroom featuring fully tiled walls and flooring, quality fitted storage presses, a spacious walk-in double electric shower, modern three-piece suite and heated radiator, creating a bright, stylish and highly functional space.

Living Area 5.15m x 4.14m
Bright and versatile open-plan living and kitchen area located within the self-contained chalet, finished with warm timber-panelled walls and vaulted ceiling creating a cosy yet spacious atmosphere. Flooded with natural light from the skylight above, this welcoming space offers excellent flexibility for everyday living, relaxing or dining, making it ideal for independent accommodation or guest use.

Bedroom 3.90m x 2.77m
Comfortable bedroom located within the self-contained chalet, featuring a warm timber-panelled vaulted ceiling with skylight, creating a bright and airy atmosphere throughout. The room enjoys excellent natural light and offers a peaceful, private setting, ideal for guest accommodation, extended family living or potential home office use.

Bathroom 2.80m x 2.28m & Sauna 1.18m X 1.09m
Stylish and modern shower room finished to a high standard, featuring a large corner shower unit, quality tiling and a private sauna, creating the perfect space to relax and unwind. The warm timber-panelled interior and vaulted ceiling add character and charm, while natural light enhances the bright and spacious feel throughout.

Garden Details
Wall and pillar entrance, tarmacadam driveway, parking area, landscaped lawn with various display of shrubs, beds, roses, poly tunnel, vegetable garden and hedging with separate lawn area to side. Raised area with seating area, patio / seating area. Mature hedging boundary. Detached store to rear plumbed for washing machine and dryer with power points.

Directions
Donoughmore Cross ( i.e Pat Barrys & Sullys)
Take L2759 towards Stuake, after c 200 m turn right, then after c. 1km take Y turn to left then after c. 1 mile take next left, you will find San Antonio on your left after c. 1 mile.

Heating 
Oil Fired Central Heating
